scope: Complete standard original 2017 core on balanced maps, normal Blight Cards and solo; supplied linked Living FAQ applicable core errata/updates, including setup-only +1 and action-tree outcomes. Adversaries/scenarios/thematic/optional difficulty/performance scoring and expansion mechanics excluded. Individual printed card/panel instructions remain authoritative.
conclusion: No material factual error, unsupported universal panel rule, or important standard-core procedural omission found in exact candidate04 bytes. The card/panel-specific exceptions stated by the candidate agree with the supplied FAQ. Excluded-module examples are not treated as additional standard-core mechanisms.

checked_claims.checked_claims: Cooperative 1–4 Spirit game, 90–120 minute guideline, shared result, original-core scope and printed exceptions.
Counts of boards, Spirits, unique/minor/major/fear/Invader/Blight cards, dividers, figures, Presence, markers, aids and progression cards.
Explorer/Town/City and Dahan Health, outgoing Damage and destruction Fear; unlimited Invaders/Dahan; no stacking limits; finite Presence.
One balanced board per Spirit, separate starting boards, board-icon population, initial box Blight with no cascade/Presence destruction.
Standard 2-player bottom-to-bottom map and pictured 3/4-player arrangements.
Invader stage randomization, one unseen omission per stage, 3/4/5 stage stack, 12-card deck in Explore.
Four Fear markers per Spirit; shuffle then use nine Fear Cards with three groups of three separated by Terror II/III.
Random Healthy-side Blight Card, hidden reverse; initial 2 per Spirit plus exactly 1 total, separate box reserve.
Minor/Major decks and separate discards; common supply; each Spirit color, starting hand and panel instructions; remaining Presence on dashed circles.
Free choice among equally valid panel setups and multiple placement instructions using same land.
Initial Explore is last setup action, card goes to Build; first Ravage empty; first actual turn begins Spirit Phase.
Intro low-complexity Spirits, progression replacement of draw-four selection, Major Forget still applies, no-card 5 per Spirit plus 1 total with no flip.
Each Spirit Growth then income then play/pay, inter-Spirit waits permitted, entire Spirit Phase precedes Fast.
Growth box all possible instructions in any order; impossible parts skipped; explicit cost must be paid.
Add Presence from either track leftmost disk, sequential placement chaining, any existing Presence reposition option and range measured before pickup.
Reposition counts as Add, not Move; Move curved arrows differ; mandatory Push/Gather and zero-distance allowed for up-to Move.
Reclaim personal discard only; destroyed Presence requires explicit permission; income highest number, not sum; Energy carries and normal nontransferability.
Card play limit, pay printed cost on play including Slow, immediate printed Elements, no targets/effects yet, no saved/shared plays or financing from later Fast income.
Reclaim One once anytime in Spirit Phase including reveal turn; uncovered track Elements continuous/additive; Any locked after chosen; action-granted flexible Element chosen immediately.
Choose Power resolution order, no interruption, forego whole effect without refund while retaining card Elements; cannot defer Fast; speed change grants no extra use.
Blighted instructions at printed timing; Fear then Ravage then Build then Explore then advance; empty Ravage/Build spaces no action.
Earned stack order, current Terror only, no looking ahead, discard resolved cards, newly earned cards appended and resolved this step; later Fear waits.
All matching lands; Stage III both terrains may interleave; Coastal card all coasts; ignore escalation without Adversary.
Eligibility list determined before card actions; additions do not add new lands, incoming Invaders participate in already queued Ravage; complete one land and triggers before next.
Total 1/2/3 Damage per Explorer/Town/City, simultaneous equal separate land/Dahan Damage, marked Damage does not reduce outgoing amount.
2+ land Damage adds one Blight; partial land Damage ignored; Dahan allocated efficiently, casualties to supply, damaged survivors remain.
Dahan do not shield land, survive then counterattack for 2 each, even if Defend reduced attack to zero; skipped Ravage no counterattack; Presence no attack.
Early Dahan Damage replaces normal timing, once per Dahan; simultaneous Damage means loss of Earth Sacred Site cannot retroactively undo its Defend.
Worked Town/Explorer/two-Dahan 3-Damage example, Blight, one dead and one damaged Dahan, Town destruction and 1 Fear.
Eligible lands add City when Towns exceed Cities, Town otherwise; no upgrade/removal; initially empty lands ineligible.
One Explorer from supply per matching eligible land with Town/City in/adjacent or Ocean adjacent; no multiplication or source from Explorer; skipped neighboring land remains source.
Ravage discard, Build to Ravage, Explore to Build; cards to personal discard; heal Damage, expire card Elements and turn effects/reminders; Energy and permanent changes persist.
Innates ordinarily free/no card play, thresholds check rather than consume Elements, same Elements reusable, card Elements only while card in play.
Target at use, measure maximum range from one Presence, Range 0 source, Sacred Site/terrain origin and target bar restrictions; slash means combined either/both.
One target/turn/use unless explicit exception; all instructions ordered, do as much as possible, no arbitrary omitted instruction; up to zero and or adjacent clauses.

Whole-Power fewer-Elements choice; Instead replaces earlier effects; thresholds checked at proper time, later gain/loss matters; speed/range checked before use and branch choices before resolving branch.
Foregoing does not count as use/target; legal attempted effects may accomplish nothing; only self-modifying innate is insufficient.
Choose Minor or Major, draw four with own-deck discard reshuffle if needed, retain one in hand, three shared discard; no hand limit and open hands.
Major requires Forget from hand/discard/play including new Major; shared discard for Minor/Major, under panel for Unique; loss of played Elements/unused activation, resolved effects persist.
Separate Major gains require separate Forgets; transfer/gift and explicitly exempt take differ; gaining mid-turn is not permission to play.
Explicit extra card play beyond normal Spirit Phase allowance; payment as instructed, instant Elements, normal speed-phase resolution unless explicit immediate use.
Unqualified Damage means Invaders, distribute freely, cumulative damage per turn, immediate destruction at Health, Health different from remaining Damage; health-change destruction at destination.
Direct Destroy ignores Health; Town/City destruction adds 1/2 Fear beyond printed Fear, Remove/Replace do not; replacement retains Damage and can subsequently be destroyed.
Per-occurrence reduction to land and Dahan separately, minimum zero, additive, whole turn; not a reduction of Spirit Damage or Dahan counterattack.
Gather into target from adjacent, Push out to adjacent, split sources/destinations, mandatory numeric counts except up-to; range boosts do not increase movement.
Ocean/off-island normally illegal; no adjacency to self, self at Range 0, legal unrestricted Move can stay in same land and count as movement.
Another Power use not card play/no printed Elements again; explicitly granted Elements repeat; new targets/choices and current threshold checks; permission selection can be deferred.
Range/speed modifiers persist, latest assigned speed controls ordinary timing, immediate repeats obey explicit timing; explicit location overrides range/target; no repeat chaining.
Powerstorm/Gift of Strength cards only; Powerstorm up to three different cards; threshold range modifiers persist without double-stacking.
Terror I all Invaders absent; II no buildings; III no Cities; final Fear earned reveals Victory without resolving card; shared noncompetitive result.
No Presence for any Spirit, lose-instructed empty Blight pool, or required missing Explore card; healthy empty pool instead flips as instructed; last existing Explore card not a loss.

Complete action tree including single-land Ravage/counterattack/cascades/triggered actions; check before next independent action/land; simultaneous win+loss sacrifice; Terror divider effects immediate for next check.
Eight balanced lands/two each terrain; corner/border adjacency across boards; only printed Ocean coasts; Ocean normally not land; your land and real Sacred Site definitions.
Presence can coexist, 3+ disks one site; effects normally island disks; destroyed disks off-track; adding/moving into existing Blight safe.
Active pool after setup; one Presence per Spirit each addition; existing Blight cascades one into one adjacent land; repeats/cross-board cascades remain original action; revisits lose Presence again.

Immediately follow empty-card flip/refill instructions while continuing cascade; reverse printed pool without second setup +1; simultaneous insufficient Healthy flips before addition, carries remaining pool, immediate effects nested.
Printed timing for effects; no-card emptiness checked at action-tree end; removed Blight to current face, never flips back, destroyed Presence not restored.
Pool to generated one per Fear, earn face-down card at full 4-per-Spirit pool and recycle markers, carry excess, dividers revealed immediately, final card text irrelevant.
Each player sequential choices not Spirit-range/Presence limited; generic any Presence/site unless explicitly Spirit-specific; repeated piece choices allowed except explicit different choices.
Each-only versus mixed global/each action grouping, action-tree outcome timing; one-action health-removal total and separate player allowances.
One board/Spirit counts; another-Spirit self-target exception without others-only bonus; multihanded roles scale by Spirits and do not acquire solo exception; Power owner and consensus/tie decisions.
Source/target restrictions survive numeric range increases; your lands remains content requirement; general arrow boosts versus Shadows targeting-only exception; revised Sky Stretches general boost.
Single-land effect fixes contents at resolution; class/island-wide effects dynamic; Encompassing Ward follows current target Spirit Presence.

After means whole originating action, not each Power instruction; cannot self-trigger indirectly; separate repeated Vengeance instances can cross-trigger without repeating own chain; corrected 3 Fear and per destroyed Town/City/Dahan Damage.

Dahan Raid/Enheartened total Damage; updated Enheartened different lands/Gather up-to-two then II 1 or III per-Dahan Damage; Trade Suffers III Coastal restriction; Overseas Trade cancels City-build entirely; Scapegoats per-land II/III.
Crops Wither first 2 Fear; Veil distinct Invader per Damage; +N threshold total not per piece; boosted Damage retains source.

Presence sharing only targeting, pseudo-shared site not real site; River special applies only to River; solo two gains/6 Energy and distinct Forgets; transferred effects use defined Spirit rules but skip inaccessible personal track.
Choose own land even if fewer effects possible; Mantle/Tidal partial contents permitted; Tidal conditional only own Push; unspecified Spirit-target Fear has no land for Dread Apparitions.
Lightning Fast-phase current-Air allowance includes innates/current-use count; Harbingers Fear target land; River Wetland site does not invent disks and 1/2-disk choice when affecting site.

Shadows Energy at use ignores numeric range only, Repeat carries surcharge; cannot omit Shadows first threshold while applying second; Green optional Choke, card Healthy/Blighted check, interleaved growth, destroyed Presence regeneration.
One Presence per moving Dahan including generic Move; Sworn to Victory after complete Ravage for each Dahan destroyed, range 1, regardless of added Blight.

Coastal Wetland for Powers/Blight on any board with Ocean Presence; not normal Growth/actions/Fear; range through Ocean for Powers/Special Rules and Growth range from existing disk; legal Powers may put others Presence there; Inland restriction requires express override.

Triggered after moves, any Ocean Presence on board, destruction Fear now, humans Drowned and Invaders held on panel; X printed Health to 1 Energy with change, no Dahan Energy, no thematic automatic Drown.

Ocean In Play persists through tree; nonhuman pieces remain out of play when ocean ceases land; failed Drown Push within action; illegal human cleanup nearest legal land before outcome, no action/move/remove/destroy/triggers; no legal land supply; destroyed-place survivors also cleaned up.

Explicit Damage/Destroy not actual except own Presence, including Dahan instructions; hypothetical whole-Power damage 0/2/5 Fear and Explorer/Town Push; no cross-Power accumulation, real prior damage aids but persists; Repeat can dream same piece; no actual-destruction bonuses.

Fear/counterattacks real Damage, Remove/Replace/Blight/action modifiers/Ravages permitted; indirect Health destruction real; Ocean Town dream+Drown 3 Fear; Spirits May Yet Dream any earned/deck Fear Card.
This Power means itself, usual Major Forget satisfies conditional, no extra Forget, forgotten card cannot later Repeat through once-this-turn permission.
